context.zh: 宮中嘗夜失火，武帝登樓望之。
context.idiomatic: Once at night the palace caught fire; Emperor Wu climbed a tower to watch.
context.literal: Once at night the palace caught fire; Emperor Wu climbed a tower to watch.

context.zh: 嘗從帝觀豕牢，言於帝曰：「豕甚肥，何不殺以享士，而使久費五穀？」
context.idiomatic: Once when following the emperor to view the pig pen he said to the emperor, "The pigs are very fat—why not slaughter them to feast the troops instead of letting them waste grain forever?"
context.literal: Once when following the emperor to view the pig pen he said to the emperor, 'The pigs are very fat—why not slaughter them to feast the troops instead of letting them waste grain forever?'

context.zh: 於是使太保衛瓘息庭、司空泰息略、太子太傅楊濟息毖、太子少師裴楷息憲、太子少傅張華息禕、尚書令華暠息恆與太子游處，以相輔導焉。

context.zh: 太子所幸蔣美人生男，又言宜隆其賞賜，多為皇孫造玩弄之器，太子從之。
context.idiomatic: When Lady Jiang, whom the crown prince favored, bore a son, they also said rewards should be lavish and many toys fashioned for the imperial grandson; the crown prince obeyed.
context.literal: When Lady Jiang, whom the crown prince favored, bore a son, they also said rewards should be lavish and many toys fashioned for the imperial grandson; the crown prince obeyed.

context.zh: 謐至東宮，或舍之而於後庭遊戲。
context.idiomatic: When Mi came to the Eastern Palace he sometimes left him waiting while he played in the inner courts.
context.literal: When Mi came to the Eastern Palace he sometimes left him waiting while he played in the inner courts.

context.zh: 又曰：「南風起兮吹白沙，遙望魯國郁嵯峨，千歲髑髏生齒牙。」
context.idiomatic: Another went: 'South wind rises blowing white sand; far off Lu kingdom gloomy and tall; thousand-year skulls sprout teeth.'
context.literal: Another went: 'South wind rises blowing white sand; far off Lu kingdom gloomy and tall; thousand-year skulls sprout teeth.'

context.zh: 二十九日早入見國家，須臾遣至中宮。
context.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth morning I entered and saw His Majesty; presently I was sent to the inner palace.
context.literal: On the twenty-ninth morning I entered and saw His Majesty; presently I was sent to the inner palace.

context.zh: '便答中宮：'陛下會同一日見賜，故不敢辭，通日不飲三升酒也。
context.idiomatic: I answered the inner palace: His Majesty granted ale one day—therefore I dared not refuse—but all day I never drank three sheng.
context.literal: I answered the inner palace: His Majesty granted ale one day—therefore I dared not refuse—but all day I never drank three sheng.

context.zh: 且實未食，恐不堪。
context.idiomatic: Moreover I had not eaten—I feared I could not endure it.
context.literal: Moreover I had not eaten—I feared I could not endure it.

context.zh: 催促云：'陛下停待。
context.idiomatic: They pressed: 'His Majesty is waiting.'
context.literal: They pressed: 'His Majesty is waiting.'

context.zh: '又小婢承福持筆研墨黃紙來，使寫。
context.idiomatic: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making me write.
context.literal: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making him write.

context.zh: 秀言于趙王倫，倫深納焉。
context.idiomatic: Sun Xiu relayed the plan to Lun, the Prince of Zhao, and Lun wholeheartedly accepted it.
context.literal: Xiu reported to Lun, Prince of Zhao, and Lun accepted fully.

context.zh: 三月，矯詔使黃門孫慮齋至許昌以害太子。
context.idiomatic: In the third month, she forged an edict and sent the Yellow Gate attendant Sun Lü to carry the pills to Xuchang and kill the crown prince.
context.literal: In the third month a forged edict sent Yellow Gate Sun Lü to Xuchang to murder the crown prince.

context.zh: 帝為太子服長子斬衰，群臣齊衰，使尚書和郁率東宮官屬具吉凶之制，迎太子喪于許昌。
context.idiomatic: The emperor wore unhemmed mourning for the crown prince as for an eldest son; the ministers wore hemmed mourning. He sent Minister He Yu to lead the Eastern Palace officials in preparing the prescribed auspicious and mourning rites and bringing the crown prince's bier back from Xuchang.

context.zh: 永康元年四月，封臨淮王。
context.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yongkang year one he was enfeoffed Prince of Linhuai.
context.literal: In the fourth month of Yongkang year one he was enfeoffed Prince of Linhuai.

context.zh: 太子官屬即轉為太孫官屬。
context.idiomatic: Eastern Palace staff transferred to grand-heir posts.
context.literal: Eastern Palace staff transferred to grand-heir posts.

context.literal: Reaching Bronze Camel Avenue palace women wept; attendants choked; passersby wiped tears.

context.zh: 既罹凶忍，徒望歸來。
